description: Union of v100_improved_only.json (19 kernels from all_shapes_v2 run) and v100_improved_low_latency.json (12 low-latency kernels for re-run after widened search space). Deduped on operator+kernel. Pruned (2026-04-26) to drop 7 kernels that showed no per-shape improvement in the iter3+agent_proposals all-shapes run: vector_add.triton_add_kernel (1.01x best, 2/16), fused_linear_jsd.triton_red_fused__to_copy_add_div_mul_sum_1 (1.00x, 0/3), kl_div.triton_red_fused_div_mul_sub_sum_xlogy_1 (1.00x, 0/2), layer_norm._layer_norm_fwd_fused (1.00x, 0/30), layer_norm.triton_per_fused_native_layer_norm_0 (1.00x, 0/1), low_mem_dropout._triton_dropout (1.00x, 0/8), sum.triton_per_fused_sum_1 (1.00x, 0/4). Renamed (2026-04-26) to track Inductor fusion-suffix renumbering after a clean V100 re-extract: rope.triton_poi_fused__to_copy_cos_mul_sin_1 -> _2 (same pointwise kernel, suffix bumped); mamba2_chunk_scan.triton_poi_fused_add_mul_4 split into _5 and _6 (Inductor now emits two pointwise add+mul kernels covering 4D and 3D layouts where there used to be one); geglu.triton_poi_fused_gelu_mul_0 retained — geglu is now in extract/run_inductor.py:_SKIP_MAX_AUTOTUNE so the standalone pointwise epilogue is still emitted alongside the matmul template.
